full.$description: Default Text Input width. The input fills the available form column, not the full page viewport.

2ch.$description: Text Input width for very short known-length values such as day or month fields inside a grouped date pattern.

3ch.$description: Text Input width for short known-length values where three characters are expected.

4ch.$description: Text Input width for known-length values such as a year field or short four-character code.

5ch.$description: Text Input width for short codes, small quantities or values that need slightly more room than four characters.

10ch.$description: Text Input width for short to medium structured values such as UK postcodes, short reference numbers or one-time codes.

20ch.$description: Text Input width for medium-length structured values such as telephone numbers, longer reference numbers or account identifiers.
